# möbius for macOS 0.10.30

Bundles gateway 0.16.48 with transient model transport retries, clearer patch rejection diagnostics, bounded progress updates and shared repetition limits for observable hosted tools. Includes refreshed built-in model defaults and compatible gateway runtime dependencies.

Protocol 97 and gateway storage formats are unchanged. Existing saved image 2.5 routes using built-in catalogs must be reselected before startup; Codex image 2.6 acceptance has not been live-verified.
